query: UPDATE namespaces AS n SET content_removed_at = now() WHERE (n.tenant_id, n.id) IN (SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $2::uuid[])) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observations AS o WHERE (o.tenant_id, o.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_operations AS g WHERE (g.tenant_id, g.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources AS s WHERE (s.tenant_id, s.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions AS c WHERE (c.tenant_id, c.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id))
